name: negative_retrieval
description: AT5: superseded, forgotten and rejected rows must not come back from recall. Each negative query has a live sibling row sharing its vocabulary, so a leak would rank against a real competitor rather than an empty result. The second cache query is the positive control: the superseded row is still stored, and only the default filter hides it. The reject action re-remembers the same text and requires the rejection guard to refuse it before the queries run.
